name: unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self :: Source
rule: Iterator adapters may rely on the source not changing during iteration, but must not rely on the source remaining unchanged in their `Drop` implementations.
api: trait SourceIter  : { unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self::Source }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it constrains behavioral reliance during iteration and `Drop`, neither of which is observable through the available inputs or current-state memory predicates.
